name: Venetian Works of Defence between the 16th and 17th Centuries: Stato da Terra – Western Stato da Mar
description: This chain of six star-shaped fortress systems stretches more than 1,000 km, from northern Italy across the Adriatic to Croatia and Montenegro. Venice built them in the 1500s and 1600s to guard its land borders and its sea routes to the Levant. Their angular corner bastions were designed to withstand cannon fire, a style that soon spread across Europe.
